ios.desc:
A pause before the scroll.

You open an app for a minute. Somehow, twenty disappear. NoMo helps you make that choice deliberately.

CHOOSE YOUR APPS
Use Apple's Screen Time controls to block the apps you want to use less.

DECIDE HOW LONG YOU NEED
Choose 1, 5, 10, or 15 minutes before you unblock an app.

PUT YOUR PHONE DOWN
Take a short pause with your phone face down on your desk, chest, or lap, or tucked in your pocket. The pause progresses while your phone is put away and stops when you pick it up. Leave NoMo open; sound and haptics let you know when the pause is complete. A simple pause is available if placement detection doesn't work for you.

CHOOSE NOT NOW
After the pause, you may find you no longer need the app. Tap Not now to keep it blocked. Your opens skipped today appear on Home as a quiet acknowledgment of that choice.

SEE YOUR HABITS CLEARLY
See today's usage, your daily average, and the last hour at a glance. Explore weekly and monthly trends, set daily and hourly targets, and let Mo's changing mood remind you to check in with yourself.

REMEMBER WHAT MATTERS
Add a reminder to yourself on Home, or connect Apple Reminders to see what you wanted to do before you reached for your phone.

A warm, quiet design. A moment to reconsider. More room for your day.

NoMo Screen Time. Mo real life.

OPTIONAL MEMBERSHIP
Every feature stays free. If NoMo helps you use your phone on your terms, an optional membership supports its continued development and removes membership invitations. Choose monthly or yearly billing. Eligible users can start with a six-month free trial; current pricing and trial terms are shown before purchase.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Privacy policy: https://www.aswathkrishnan.com/p/privacy-policy-for-nomo.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

quotes.text:
Plug for the app I built that's helping me significantly: NoMo Screentime

It blocks all distracting apps. To unblock, I need to choose # of minutes upfront, then pause and put my phone face down for sometime. And then, it unblocks the app for the time I requested, and blocks it again.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/nomo-screen-time/id6748623068

I’m so tired of social media rotting brains and ruining health and relationships. But also find it hard to completely quit Instagram/Linkedin/X as I get some value out of it. Sewer in the water line situation.

Built a screentime app to automatically block after chosen number of mins and it’s helping me. Completely free to try: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/nomo-reduce-screen-time/id6748623068
